channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Seagate finds 'AI is increasing the value of data' but warns that 43% of businesses lack proper data storage infrastructure — 99% expect AI storage (and storage costs) to explode
item.description: Seagate’s survey finds AI increasing storage requirements sharply, while many organizations remain unprepared for infrastructure, sustainability and data-management demands.

item.title: AMD GPUs and CPUs could be the next victims of the RAM crisis, as industry chatter insists more price hikes are coming
item.description: AMD plans 10% price hikes across its 'entire chip line' in Q4 going by latest RAM crisis rumor.

item.title: Disney’s first CTO led an AI startup it once accused of copying its characters
item.description: The former CEO of Character.AI, which Disney previously sent a cease-and-desist letter to, will serve as the company's first-ever chief technology officer.

item.title: In India, the new iPhone can arrive faster than a pizza
item.description: Availability of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series turned patchy within hours of its debut on India's quick-commerce apps.

item.title: China's Salt Typhoon spotted probing Latin American government with newly developed SparroWocky backdoor
item.description: The group has been focused on Latin America for almost a year now.

item.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
item.description: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.

item.title: Joby Aviation’s 3,100-mile autonomous flight signals its push beyond electric air taxis
item.description: An aircraft equipped with Joby Aviation's autonomy technology flew across the United States without a human pilot taking control at any point.

item.title: Global AI safety is hinging on U.S.-China cooperation, but they see each other as the problem
item.description: The superpowers are skeptical of each other’s AI strategy. As concern rises over the risks of artificial intelligence, hopes for any kind of global approach depend on cooperation between the U.S. and China — superpowers that seem only to be more skeptical of each other’s AI strategy.AI governance is expected to be on the agenda in a meeting planned for next week in Washington between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping. The topic has gained urgency in both countries, with American tech leaders saying that averting worst-case scenarios for rogue AI depends on a degree of cooper...

item.title: A major Wendy’s franchisee with 314 stores just filed for bankruptcy. What it means for the burger chain’s footprint
item.description: In a blow to the Wendy’s brand, the franchisee cited “sustained system-wide headwinds” and broader company struggles in its Chapter 11 filing. Despite being the third-largest fast-food hamburger chain in the world and the second-largest in the U.S. after McDonald’s, Wendy’s has struggled lately with declining sales and a shrinking store footprint.

item.title: Dario Amodei and other AI leaders want to ‘Pace the Frontier’ but…how?
item.description: A week after an Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning rattled the AI world, the company’s CEO Dario Amodei has outlined his plan to “pace the frontier” of AI development. The proposal leans on independent safety evaluators and coordination between AI labs in democratic countries, and it’s already picked up some industry support, along with some pointed pushback from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang. Watch […]...

item.title: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
item.description: It's one of the most fascinating years in a while when it comes to iPhone camera upgrades. The big story of the iPhone 18 Pro is the variable aperture main lens, which lets you open the aperture up wider for better low light shots and make the aperture smaller for better depth of field in […]

item.title: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) is positioning the state to take the lead on AI oversight, including the potential to mandate a "kill switch" for frontier models, with a new executive order issued Friday. Newsom's order directs the state to convene a group of experts that will deliver recommendations within two months on how to […]

item.title: J’ai testé le Leica SL3-P : 45 Mpx, 40 i/s… le Leica qui veut tout faire
item.description: 45 mégapixels, 40 images par seconde, autofocus à détection de phase et vidéo 8K : avec le SL3-P, Leica signe le premier boîtier de sa gamme qui refuse enfin de choisir entre la pure définition et la vitesse pure. Mais cette belle polyvalence suffit-elle à justifier son ticket d'entrée à 5 990 euros ? On fait le point.

item.title: Pour ses 80 ans, EDF ouvre 70 sites secrets au public, dont ses centrales nucléaires
item.description: Vous faites quoi ce week-end ? Nous, on pourrait bien se rendre à Civaux ou à Flamanville pour visiter les installations nucléaires d'EDF. Pour ses 80 ans, l'électricien français met le paquet à l'occasion des journées du patrimoine 2026, et ouvre les portes de 70 sites de production.

item.title: 2,000 UK flight cancellations caused by ‘previously unknown defect’ that happened in the ‘space of a millisecond’ — travel chaos took days to fix and left hundreds of thousands stranded
item.description: A report from Nats found that the disruption stemmed from a manual request for a squawk code that was corrupted during processing.

item.title: The next phase of design will still be human-led
item.description: At the Fast Company Innovation Festival, three design leaders from Spotify, Block, and Brooks, unpacked the new rules of design. Someone can convert an idea into reality faster than ever before with the help of generative AI, and that makes the role of humans in the process even more important. “More is not always better. Faster is not always better,” said Emily Galloway, Spotify’s senior director of product design, at The New Rules of Great Design panel during the 2026 Fast Company Innovation Festival. “Human judgment is becoming so important.”...

item.title: 1 heure et 4 erreurs : comment l’IA a métamorphosé ma vieille liseuse en écran domotique
item.description: Une Kobo Sage qu'on m'a offerte il y a des années, qui sortait deux fois l'an pour un train, et un rêve de gamin : voir d'un coup d'œil la température des pièces, la météo et les lumières restées allumées, sur un écran dans la maison. Une IA agentique l'a fait pour moi en une heure. Elle s'est aussi trompée quatre fois.

item.title: Manus seeks $4B valuation in new $500M fundraise as it resumes independent ops
item.description: Manus, which earlier this year had to break off a merger with Meta, is in discussions to raise $500M at a $4B valuation.

item.title: What Hollywood thinks about existential AI warnings
item.description: As the tech sector sounds alarms about AI's potential to destroy humanity, entertainment labor groups are urging the public to stay focused on what's already happening. The Verge reached out to Disney, Netflix, Amazon, Lionsgate, and other studios who have started using AI, as well film startups focused on bringing generative AI into the mainstream […]...

item.title: Mesures de sécurité supplémentaires | Le gouverneur de la Californie signe un décret pour encadrer les acteurs de l’IA
item.description: Le gouverneur démocrate de la Californie Gavin Newsom a signé vendredi un décret qui vise à pousser les acteurs de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) à prendre des mesures de sécurité supplémentaires pour gérer les risques de l’IA.

item.title: FBI confirms two Texas-bound oil tankers hit by hackers who disabled coms and put the engines into overdrive — and Iran is possibly to blame
item.description: The FBI had to board at least one of the vessels to investigate the incident.

item.title: I spoke to Apple’s new VP of Hardware Engineering about why he's ‘especially proud’ of the iPhone Duo’s hinge durability and the reliability of Ceramic Shield 2: ‘When I see someone put a screen protector on their iPhone, it makes my skin crawl’
item.description: Ahead of the iPhone 18 Pro's official launch, we sat down with Apple’s new VP of Hardware Engineering, Tom Marieb, to discuss the durability credentials of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.

item.title: Les mythiques courses de pod de Star Wars reviennent bientôt dans Galactic Racer, en précommande à 44,99 € sur PS5
item.description: Star Wars Galactic Racer est un jeu de courses arcade dans l'univers de Star Wars, inspiré des scènes de La Menace Fantôme. Il est en préco PS5 sur Amazon à 44,99 euros au lieu de 59,99 euros.

item.title: Test du Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G, le smartphone qui mise tout sur l’autonomie
item.description: Pour offrir une autonomie hors norme, le Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 Pro embarque une batterie de 8340 mAh ainsi que le processeur Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 de Qualcomm.
